Frequently Asked Questions

How long does a home remodel take?

Timing varies with design decisions, project size, material availability, permit review, and existing conditions. A project-specific schedule is prepared after the scope is defined.

Can you change an existing floor plan?

Yes, when the existing structure and approved plans allow it. Structural changes — such as removing load-bearing walls — require engineering evaluation, appropriate structural solutions, and permits through the applicable local authority.

Do remodeling projects in Tampa Bay require permits?

Whole-home and structural remodeling projects in Florida typically require building permits for any work involving structural changes, electrical, plumbing, or HVAC modifications. Unique Building Contractors manages the permit application and all required inspections through the applicable local authority — Hillsborough County, Pinellas County, Pasco County, or Sarasota County depending on project location.

Can you work in a home while the family is still living there?

Yes. Most of our remodeling projects take place in occupied homes. We develop phasing plans, install dust containment barriers, and schedule high-impact work around your household routine to keep disruption to a minimum.
